title: 3.5.11 Chart the Code: Tracing a Nested Access
description: Chart a loop that reads a nested field inside an array, then a decision on a nested value. Get the loop's arrows landing in the right place.

aiGrader.prompt: This chart is scored entirely by rules from its shapes and arrows. No model reads it.

rubric.title: The loop is drawn with the loop-setup hexagon

steps.fail: The for-loop header has its own shape, the loop-setup hexagon from the shape palette.
steps.pass: A loop-setup hexagon is on the path.

rubric.title: A task inside the loop adds each price to the total
rubric.description: Scored by the editor (arrow order): the task that adds the price sits inside the repeat.

steps.fail: The loop body is the task that adds each item's price to the total, and it must lead back to the hexagon so it runs once per item.
steps.pass: The adding task runs once per item, inside the loop.

rubric.title: The loop, then more steps after it
rubric.description: Scored by the editor (arrow order): the loop repeats, the arrow that leaves it leads on to the steps after it, and no arrow goes around the loop to the VIP test.

steps.fail: The adding task must lead back to the hexagon, and the arrow that leaves the loop must lead on to the name task, the decision and the print (at least two more steps before End).
steps.pass: The way out of the loop leads on to the steps after it.

steps.fail: The loop must run before the VIP test on every route: no arrow may go around the hexagon straight to the steps after it.
steps.pass: Every route to the VIP test goes through the loop.

rubric.title: The VIP decision is outside the loop
rubric.description: Scored by the editor (arrow order): the decision that asks about the customer is not part of a repeat. A diamond that runs the loop ("more items?") may sit inside it.

steps.fail: The VIP test runs once, after the loop. In your chart an arrow leads back to the diamond that asks about the customer, so it runs on every pass (or no diamond asks about the customer at all).
steps.pass: The decision is outside the loop.

rubric.title: The decision asks about the customer
rubric.description: Scored by the editor: a diamond asks about the customer (the vip flag).

steps.fail: The diamond should ask about the customer: is the order from a VIP.
steps.pass: The diamond asks about the customer.

rubric.title: Each exit of the VIP decision has its own print
rubric.description: Scored by the editor (arrow order): the yes arrow of the VIP decision leads to the VIP print and the no arrow to a different print.

steps.fail: Each exit of the diamond leads to its own print: the yes arrow to the VIP print (say VIP in it), the no arrow to the other print.
steps.pass: Each exit of the diamond has its own print.

gate.fail: None of your shapes say what this program does. Label each shape in your own words.
